SETTINGS_TICK_RES_HINT: How fine-grained one simulation tick is. Caps the fastest clock the waveform can represent without aliasing.
SETTINGS_TICK_RES_HIGH: High precision (1 ns · up to 500 MHz)
SETTINGS_TICK_RES_DEFAULT_DESC: ⚠ Traduction en attente — description affichée en anglais. Backwards-compatible with existing snapshots and lessons. Fastest runs and lowest memory. Clocks above 50 MHz alias down to 50 MHz.
SETTINGS_TICK_RES_HIGH_DESC: ⚠ Traduction en attente — description affichée en anglais. Accurate visualisation up to 500 MHz. Expect ~10x slower simulations and ~10x more signal-history memory per run.
SETTINGS_TICK_RES_ADAPTIVE_DESC: ⚠ Traduction en attente — description affichée en anglais. Picks the coarsest tick that still gives at least two ticks per clock period. Only pays the precision cost when the effective clock needs it.

HOME_TITLE: Kmila-9s: Un outil multiplateforme d'apprentissage et de debogage VHDL
HOME_SUBTITLE: Une application pour apprendre et deboguer le code VHDL sans necessite de materiel physique.
HOME_OVERVIEW_P1: Kmila-9s est une application de bureau multiplateforme, fonctionnant dans un environnement local, destinee au debogage du code VHDL (langage de description materielle VHSIC). Son objectif est de faciliter l'analyse des programmes a travers la simulation et la visualisation interactive des signaux numeriques, des cycles d'horloge et des etats des ports.
HOME_OVERVIEW_P2: Le projet vise a soutenir l'apprentissage academique de la conception numerique pour les FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Arrays), en offrant un outil gratuit et open-source qui renforce les pratiques educatives et permet une comprehension pratique de la logique des systemes numeriques sans necessite de materiel physique.
HOME_FEATURE_VISUALIZATION_DESC: Observez les etats des signaux, des ports et des variables internes a tout moment.
HOME_FEATURE_CROSSPLATFORM_DESC: Fonctionne sur Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, iPadOS et Linux (via web).
HOME_FEATURE_PRELAB_DESC: Preparez-vous a l'avance pour les sessions de laboratoire physique.
HOME_FEATURE_ACCESSIBILITY_DESC: Etudiez depuis n'importe quel ordinateur ou appareil mobile.
HOME_FEATURE_PROTOTYPING_DESC: Validez les conceptions plus rapidement qu'avec les methodes traditionnelles.

LEARN_SUBTITLE: From your very first bit to a pipelined CPU — guided readings, worked samples, fix-the-bug exercises, and full projects. Track your progress and open anything straight into the Kmila editor.
LEARN_EMPTY_BODY: The curriculum manifest couldn't be loaded. Try reopening the app or check the logs.
LEARN_LESSON_NOT_FOUND_BODY: That lesson isn't in the current curriculum. It may have been renamed or removed.
LEARN_LESSON_BODY_MISSING: The reading for this lesson hasn't been translated yet — showing the English version as a fallback.
LEARN_FALLBACK_TO_EN: Affichage en anglais — cette leçon n'est pas encore traduite.
LEARN_TRACK_BEGINNER_BLURB: Binary, boolean algebra, gates — the mental model you need before you write a single line of VHDL.
LEARN_TRACK_EASY_BLURB: VHDL syntax, combinational design, simulation. Short lessons, one concept each.
LEARN_TRACK_INTERMEDIATE_BLURB: Processes, flip-flops, counters, finite-state machines — the moment static circuits start to remember.
LEARN_TRACK_ADVANCED_BLURB: Memories, ALUs, small CPUs, bus protocols. Multi-module designs where pieces talk to each other.
LEARN_TRACK_EXPERT_BLURB: Pipelining, hazards, verification, SoC integration. The material from a Sistemas en Chip or Computer Architecture course.
LEARN_SAMPLE_TRY_BODY: Create a throw-away project seeded with this sample and jump straight to the workbench.
LEARN_SAMPLE_FIX_BODY: We give you a design that doesn't quite work. Open it, find the bug, make it build and simulate correctly.
LEARN_SAMPLE_PROJECT_BODY: Open the starter scaffold and build the design from there. Acceptance criteria and sample stimuli are in the reading above.
